profile.name: Abhishek Prajapati
profile.bio:
I'm a full stack developer with 2.5+ years of production experience shipping scalable web and mobile applications. My day-to-day toolkit revolves around the MERN stack, Next.js, and React Native — but what I care about most is building products that hold up under real users: real-time systems that stay snappy with 500+ concurrent connections, APIs that answer 10,000+ requests a month without breaking a sweat, and interfaces that feel effortless.

At Future IT Touch in Chandigarh I wore a lot of hats — architecting backends with Node.js, Express, and Laravel, designing MongoDB schemas with indexing strategies that cut response times by 35%, and deploying everything to AWS EC2 with S3-backed storage. One of my favorite achievements there was leading a complete UI/UX revamp of the company website: within three months it drove 40% traffic growth, a 60% rise in page views, and a 90% improvement in average session duration. That experience taught me that performance and polish aren't luxuries — they're growth levers.

These days at Gigsoft Pro I focus on production-grade merchant and invoicing platforms, cross-platform mobile apps, and mentoring junior developers. I write about what I learn on my blog, and I'm always open to interesting problems — whether that's a real-time feature that needs to scale, a payment flow that needs to be bulletproof, or an app that needs to ship on iOS and Android from one codebase.
